description: This module manages IP on Scaleway account https://developer.scaleway.com.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Scaleway organization identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project identifier. Exactly one of project and organization must be specified.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example par1). Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Reverse to assign to the IP.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: ID of the server you want to attach an IP to. To unattach an IP do not specify this option.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the IP. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create an IP with a project ID
  community.general.scaleway_ip:
    project: '{{ project_id }}'
    state: present
    region: par1
  register: ip_creation_task

- name: Make sure IP deleted
  community.general.scaleway_ip:
    id: '{{ ip_creation_task.scaleway_ip.id }}'
    state: absent
    region: par1

- name: Create an IP in the default project with an organization ID (deprecated)
  community.general.scaleway_ip:
    organization: '{{ scw_org }}'
    state: present
    region: par1
  register: ip_creation_task

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: This is only present when state=present. Returned: when state=present Sample: {"ips": [{"address": "212.47.232.136", "id": "dd9e8df6-6775-4863-b517-e0b0ee3d7477", "organization": "951df375-e094-4d26-97c1-ba548eeb9c42", "reverse": null, "server": {"id": "3f1568ca-b1a2-4e98-b6f7-31a0588157f1", "name": "ansible_tuto-1"}}]}
